items.context: Quinten (con gráfico): Bitcoin cotiza bajo TODAS las medias móviles principales (100DMA $77,7K, 365DMA $75,6K, 50WMA $75K, 200DMA $72,6K, 200WMA $68K). Dice que el gráfico se ve muy mal, pero que son justo el tipo de condiciones que él siempre ha preferido (el texto sigue en el enlace del post).
items.suggested_text:
Moving averages lag by design, so stacking all five mostly confirms what the drawdown already told us. The one with real history behind it is the 200WMA: closes below it have been rare, and they've tended to cluster in the late, exhausted phase of bear markets rather than at the start.

At ~$58-59K, BTC sits roughly 13-15% under it. Price vs the 200WMA is one of the four inputs in my Market Temperature index, next to MVRV, drawdown from the ATH and volatility-adjusted 90-day momentum, and that index went from 99.29 to 0.67 in 364 days. Readings that cold have never worked as a timing tool on their own.

What usually separates a floor from a trap isn't where price sits against the averages, but how long it stays there and who is still left to sell.
